scope: Expose existing web market scores and portfolio risk concentration in native readers, preserving native analysis and actions.

market.before: Native return comparisons and instrument rows omitted web opportunity_score, momentum_score and momentum_roc_score.
market.after: Current instrument rows expose a Market scores disclosure with existing opportunity score,3M price trend score and trend change score; selected lens description provides existing source context. Existing metadata-loading status/retry is visible outside the volume panel.
source_contracts: services/market.py:build_momentum_profiles_from_bars assigns momentum_score=slope_3m and momentum_roc_score=mean of existing horizon-slope ratios.
services/market_opportunity.py returns opportunity_score,momentum_score,momentum_roc_score. Existing native join retains complete momentum universe with per-symbol research metadata.
web/app/market-explorer/page.tsx uses these same fields in momentum scatter,3Dcolor and ranked table.
market.display_semantics: Raw scores remain scores, with no percent conversion or probability claim. One compact mapping keeps signed values with existing formatters and omits absent/nonfinite score fields; the disclosure is omitted when no score exists. No replacement of return plots,3Dreturns,volume,matrix,sorting,universe or Investigator navigation.

portfolio.before: Native Risk scatter used return color and constant size and omitted web risk_share/gross_market_value elsewhere.
portfolio.after: Existing Risk Positions table now includes Gross position value inUSD and Share of portfolio risk aspercent. Existing scatter,correlation/factors and diagnostics remain.
source_contracts: services/robinhood_main_analytics.py sums absolute position values into gross_market_value.
risk_share is the existing signed covariance contribution divided by portfolio variance; it can be negative for offsets.
web/app/portfolio/page.tsx displays gross_market_value via marker size and risk_share via marker color.
portfolio.display_semantics: USD gross values and signed fractional risk shares use existing money/fraction formatters. No absolute value,clamp,new risk calculation or backend change.

native_types_reviewed: existing Metrics grid and native navigation

limits: No Xcode build,Simulator/device render or installation performed here; final integrated native gate remains root-owned.
This scoped source change does not establish appwide parity. Home,Health and Trading are owned by the separate native parity work.
